doc.summary: MCP tool ``lazyown_get_config``: read the current payload.json config.
doc.description:
First tool migrated out of the ``lazyown_mcp`` god-file into the
one-file-per-tool registry. It is the reference implementation: a ``TOOL``
schema plus a ``handle`` function that takes its dependencies from the
injected :class:`mcp_tools._context.MCPContext` and imports nothing from
the runtime.

name: TOOL
value: types.Tool(name='lazyown_get_config', description='Read the current LazyOwn configuration (payload.json). Returns all settings.', inputSchema={'type': 'object', 'properties': {}})

name: handle
signature: def handle(arguments: dict[str, Any], tool_name: str, ctx: MCPContext) -> list

doc.summary: Return the full ``payload.json`` as pretty-printed JSON text.

params.name: arguments
params.description: Unused; the tool takes no parameters.

params.name: tool_name
params.description: The dispatched tool name, used for the text envelope.

returns.description: A one-element ``TextContent`` list holding the config JSON.
